scholarships.name: Chevening Scholarships
scholarships.provider_name: UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (Chevening)
scholarships.value_text: Tuition fees, monthly living stipend, economy return flight, arrival and departure allowances and visa application cost
scholarships.summary: UK government scholarship for a one-year taught master's degree at a UK university, aimed at future leaders who commit to returning home for at least two years after the award ends.
scholarships.criteria_text: Citizen of a Chevening-eligible country; undergraduate degree qualifying for a UK master's; at least two years' (2,800 hours) work experience after the first degree; apply to three eligible UK courses; unconditional offer from one by 8 July 2027; return home for two years.
scholarships.deadline_note: Applications for 2027/28 opened in August 2026 and closed in October 2026 (11:00 UTC); the Pakistan page now states they are closed. Unconditional offer due 8 July 2027.
scholarships.notes: Exact closing day for 2027/28 not shown on official pages opened. Coverage taken from Chevening Terms and Conditions (August 2026 PDF); MBA tuition contribution capped at GBP 22,000; dependants not covered. Eligibility from chevening.org/resource-hub/guidance/eligibility/.

scholarships.name: Commonwealth Master's Scholarships
scholarships.provider_name: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK (funded by the UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office)
scholarships.value_text: Full tuition fees, return airfare, monthly stipend of GBP 1,712 (GBP 2,000 in the London area) and a study travel grant
scholarships.summary: UK government funded master's scholarships for citizens of eligible Commonwealth countries, including Pakistan, who could not otherwise afford UK study. Candidates apply to the CSC and are nominated by a national nominating agency.
scholarships.criteria_text: Citizen of and permanently resident in an eligible Commonwealth country; first degree of at least 2:1 standard (or 2:2 plus a relevant postgraduate qualification) by September 2027; unable to afford UK study without the award; available to start by September 2027.
scholarships.deadline_note: CSC closing date 16:00 BST, 20 October 2026. Nominators set their own, often earlier, deadlines; in Pakistan the nominator is HEC. Nominations to the CSC by December 2026; outcomes by July 2027.
scholarships.notes: HEC's Pakistan nomination deadline and selection criteria could not be verified: hec.gov.pk announcement page blocked to automated fetching. CSC page states the year of the 20 October deadline only by context.

scholarships.name: Commonwealth PhD Scholarships
scholarships.provider_name: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK (funded by the UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office)
scholarships.value_text: Full funding including a monthly stipend of GBP 1,712 (GBP 2,000 in the London area), at current rates
scholarships.summary: UK government funded doctoral scholarships for citizens of eligible Commonwealth countries, including Pakistan. Candidates apply to the CSC and must also be nominated, mainly by a national nominating agency.
scholarships.criteria_text: Citizen of an eligible Commonwealth country; first degree of at least 2:1 standard, or 2:2 plus a relevant postgraduate qualification (usually a master's), by September 2027.
scholarships.deadline_note: CSC closing date 16:00 BST, 20 October 2026. Nominators may set earlier closing dates; in Pakistan the nominator is HEC.
scholarships.notes: Full list of covered costs beyond the stipend not returned by the PhD page; HEC nomination deadline not verified.

scholarships.name: Fulbright Program for Pakistan (Master's and PhD)
scholarships.provider_name: United States Educational Foundation in Pakistan (USEFP)
scholarships.value_text: Tuition, required textbooks, airfare, a living stipend and health insurance
scholarships.summary: Fully funded Master's and PhD study in the United States for Pakistani candidates, administered by USEFP. Open to all fields except clinical medicine, with priority given to sciences, technology and AI, trade and economics and natural resource management.
scholarships.criteria_text: Master's: 16 years of formal education; PhD: 18 years (Master's or MPhil). Minimum GRE score of 145 in each section; selected candidates take the TOEFL. PhD scholars sign an HEC bond to return and serve in Pakistan.
scholarships.deadline_note: Applications for the 2027 Fulbright Program closed on 1 April 2026; results mid September, departures from July. The next cycle has not been announced.
scholarships.notes: Priority fields and clinical medicine exclusion from USEFP's own newsletter (newsletter.usefp.org, January 2026).

scholarships.name: US-UK Fulbright Postgraduate Awards
scholarships.value_text: Financial packages vary by award; some awards are fully funded
scholarships.summary: Postgraduate awards for UK applicants to study a master's or PhD in the United States, with either Commission-assisted (IIE) placement or independent applications to US universities.
scholarships.criteria_text: UK citizen (UK-based non-citizens with settled or pre-settled status may be considered; not on a Student visa); not a dual US-UK citizen or Green Card holder; at least a 2:1 undergraduate degree (2:2 in exceptional cases).
scholarships.deadline_note: Applications for 2027/28 opened in February 2026 and closed at 17:00 BST on 5 May 2026.
scholarships.notes: Award values not published as amounts; value_type full_funding applies only to some awards. Independent placement applicants must secure US admission before the award begins.

scholarships.name: Australia Awards Scholarships (Pakistan)
scholarships.value_text: Full tuition fees, return air travel, establishment allowance, contribution to living expenses and overseas student health cover
scholarships.summary: Australian Government scholarships for Pakistani professionals to complete a master's degree in Australia in priority development fields, returning to Pakistan for at least two years afterwards.
scholarships.criteria_text: Aged 45 or under at application; 16 years of education and five years of relevant work experience in Pakistan; IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with no band below 6.0 (or TOEFL/PTE); priority fields: climate change, women and girls' empowerment, agriculture and water security, infrastructure, inclusive economic development.
scholarships.deadline_note: Intake 2027 applications ran from 1 February 2026 (09:00 AEDT) to 30 April 2026 (14:00 AEST) and are closed.
scholarships.notes: field_slugs left empty because the published priority fields do not map cleanly to site field slugs; review before publishing.

scholarships.name: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: University Composition Fee, maintenance allowance (GBP 23,152 for 12 months at the 2026-27 rate), economy airfare, visa costs and Immigration Health Surcharge
scholarships.summary: Full-cost scholarships for applicants from any country outside the UK to study a full-time PhD, MLitt or one-year postgraduate course at the University of Cambridge.
scholarships.criteria_text: Citizen of any country outside the United Kingdom; applying for an eligible full-time postgraduate course at Cambridge; selection on academic excellence and social leadership potential.
scholarships.deadline_note: Non-US applicants: deadline 8 December 2026 or 6 January 2027 depending on course; outcomes by 8 March 2027.
scholarships.notes: Coverage from gatescambridge.org/programme/the-scholarship/. Maintenance figure is the 2026-27 rate; 2027-28 rate not yet published.

scholarships.name: Rhodes Scholarship (Pakistan)
scholarships.value_text: University of Oxford course fees, annual stipend (GBP 20,400 in 2025-26), visa fees, Immigration Health Surcharge and two economy flights
scholarships.summary: Fully funded postgraduate scholarship for full-time study at the University of Oxford. Two scholarships are available each year for the Pakistan constituency.
scholarships.criteria_text: Pakistan constituency criteria are set out in the Information for Candidates document (not opened); applicants must choose an eligible full-time Oxford postgraduate course.
scholarships.deadline_note: Pakistan applications ran from 1 June 2026 to 23:59 PKT on 5 August 2026 and are closed. Applications reopen in 2027 for 2028 entry.
scholarships.notes: Pakistan eligibility criteria (age, citizenship, grades) not verified; stipend figure is the 2025-26 rate.

scholarships.name: DAAD Development-Related Postgraduate Courses (EPOS)
scholarships.value_text: Monthly stipend, health, accident and liability insurance, travel allowance and, where applicable, rent subsidy and family allowances
scholarships.summary: DAAD scholarships for professionals from development and newly industrialised countries to take selected development-related master's or doctoral courses at German universities, applying directly to the chosen course.
scholarships.criteria_text: Bachelor's degree (usually four years) in the upper third, normally not more than six years old; at least two years' related professional experience after the first degree; IELTS 6 or TOEFL iBT 80 for English-taught courses.
scholarships.deadline_note: Deadlines for intake 2027/28 vary by course; DAAD's June 2026 course list refers applicants to each course website. Up to three courses may be chosen.
scholarships.notes: Pakistan's place on the EPOS eligible-country list not confirmed on an opened page (list link and DAAD Pakistan programme page could not be read). Monthly rate conflicts: EUR 934 on the EPOS page versus EUR 992 on DAAD's general scholarships page.

scholarships.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters Scholarships
scholarships.value_text: Participation costs plus a contribution to travel, visa and living costs
scholarships.summary: EU-funded scholarships for joint master's programmes of one to two years delivered by consortia of universities in several countries, some including German universities. Students worldwide apply directly to each programme.
scholarships.criteria_text: Bachelor's degree, or in final year of bachelor's studies, or recognised equivalent learning; programme-specific requirements apply.
scholarships.deadline_note: Most programmes take applications between October and January for courses starting the following academic year; check each programme.
scholarships.notes: Monthly allowance amount not stated on official pages opened. Germany applies only where a German university is in the consortium; not all programmes offer scholarships.

scholarships.name: Canada Graduate Research Scholarship - Doctoral (CGRS-D)
scholarships.provider_name: Government of Canada research granting agencies (NSERC, SSHRC, CIHR)
scholarships.summary: Federal doctoral scholarship that replaced the Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarships. Up to 15% of awards are available to international applicants registered in a doctoral programme at an eligible Canadian institution.
scholarships.criteria_text: Registered in a doctoral programme at an eligible Canadian institution by the application deadline; apply through that institution if it holds an agency quota.
scholarships.deadline_note: Agency deadline 20:00 ET on 17 October (year not stated on page); institutional deadlines are earlier. Results by 30 April.
scholarships.notes: Only relevant to students already registered in a Canadian PhD; not an entry route for new applicants from Pakistan.

scholarships.name: Research Training Program (RTP) Scholarships
scholarships.value_text: Can include a tuition fee offset, a living-cost stipend and allowances, as awarded by each university
scholarships.summary: Australian Government block grant that funds scholarships for domestic and overseas students in research doctorates and research master's degrees. Each university runs its own application and selection.
scholarships.criteria_text: Admission to a higher degree by research at an Australian higher education provider; provider-specific criteria apply.
scholarships.notes: Components awarded vary by university, so full_funding may overstate some awards. Stipend rate table did not render.

scholarships.name: Deutschlandstipendium
scholarships.provider_name: German Federal Government with private sponsors
scholarships.value_text: Monthly scholarship funded jointly by the federal government and private sponsors
scholarships.summary: Merit scholarship co-funded by the German federal government and private sponsors, open to first-year and continuing students of all nationalities, who apply directly to their German university.
scholarships.criteria_text: Students of all nationalities enrolled or starting at a participating German university; university-specific criteria and deadlines.
scholarships.notes: Monthly amount and duration not confirmed on the official site (detail pages failed to load); only university and third-party pages stated an amount, which were not used.

scholarships.name: Aga Khan Foundation International Scholarship Programme
scholarships.value_text: Half grant, half loan; the loan half is repayable with a service charge and needs a guarantor
scholarships.summary: Need-based postgraduate awards for outstanding students from selected developing countries, including Pakistan, with priority for master's study. Not currently available for study in the United Kingdom.
scholarships.criteria_text: Excellent academic record; bachelor's degree or equivalent; genuine financial need; multi-source funding plan; admission to a reputable postgraduate institution; first-year students only; preference for applicants under 30.
scholarships.deadline_note: The 2026-2027 cycle is closed; the next cycle opens in early 2027.
scholarships.notes: Destination codes inferred: the page excludes only the UK and Russia and does not name host countries. value_type partial_tuition is the closest allowed value; the page does not say which costs the award covers. Award amounts not published.
